version: 0.4.0
kind: manifest
schema_type: manifest

metadata:
  udi: prismata.meta.schema.manifest
  name: manifest.schema
  description: Canonical base schema for all Prismata manifests.

spec:
  target_kind: manifest
  naming:
    file_suffix: .manifest.yaml
  versioning:
    semver: true

fields:
  - name: udi
    path: udi
    type: string
    required: true

  - name: id
    path: id
    type: string
    required: true

  - name: name
    path: name
    type: string
    required: true

  - name: version
    path: version
    type: string
    required: true

  - name: description
    path: description
    type: string
    required: false

  - name: tags
    path: tags
    type: array
    required: false

  - name: metadata
    path: metadata
    type: object
    required: false

object:
  udi: ""
  id: ""
  name: ""
  version: ""
  description: ""
  tags: []
  metadata: {}
